inheritanceRule: Every omitted field inherits the resolved parent class value.

profiles.name: Gun Chemist

evidence.reason: Bomb power is infused directly into firearm ammunition and supported by gunsmithing and reload features.

profiles.playerSummary: An Alchemist who loads bomb-like alchemical ordnance into firearms and modifies it through specialised discoveries.
profiles.tradeoff: Firearms, ammunition and unstable infused shots replace ordinary thrown-bomb flexibility.

profiles.name: Vivisectionist

evidence.reason: The entire bomb progression is replaced by full Rogue-equivalent sneak attack.

profiles.playerSummary: A surgical Alchemist who abandons bombs for full sneak attack, anatomical expertise and disturbing transformation procedures.
profiles.tradeoff: Reliable area damage disappears and the strongest offence depends on qualifying for sneak attack.

profiles.name: Detective

professionIdentity.evidenceText: The archetype explicitly investigates evidence, lies, magical traps and hidden information.

evidence.reason: Investigation bonuses, trapfinding, divinations and anti-deception magic define the archetype.

profiles.playerSummary: A Bard detective who coordinates careful allies and investigates traps, disguises, lies and hidden magical evidence.
profiles.tradeoff: Several iconic inspiration performances and broad bardic knowledge are replaced by investigative specialisation.

profiles.name: Arcane Healer

professionIdentity.evidenceText: The named archetype explicitly converts performance and channel energy into group healing.

evidence.reason: Positive channeling and performance-powered cure spells make healing a defining role.
Positive channel energy can damage undead.

profiles.playerSummary: A Bard healer who channels positive energy and converts performance rounds into progressively stronger cure magic.
profiles.tradeoff: Several versatile performances are replaced by a focused healing resource package.

profiles.name: Nature Fang

evidence.reason: Wild shape is completely replaced by Slayer talents and sneak attack.

profiles.playerSummary: A Druid who abandons wild shape for studied target, sneak attack and a full progression of Slayer talents.
profiles.tradeoff: The class’s defining personal transformation is lost for a stealthier martial toolkit.

profiles.name: Reincarnated Druid

evidence.reason: Automatic reincarnation and repeated resistance to death distinguish the archetype without changing the coarse role profile.

profiles.playerSummary: A mysterious Druid who repeatedly returns in a new body and develops exceptional resistance to death and necromancy.
profiles.tradeoff: Wild shape arrives late and functions two levels behind the normal Druid progression.

profiles.name: Storm Druid

constraints.summary: Nature bond must be Air, Weather, Cloud, Storm or Wind; an animal companion is forbidden.

evidence.reason: The animal companion and spontaneous summon-nature’s-ally engine are both removed, though prepared summons remain possible.

profiles.playerSummary: A domain-bound Druid of wind, weather and storms who casts domain magic spontaneously and ignores severe weather.
profiles.tradeoff: The animal companion is forbidden and spontaneous summoning is replaced by a narrow mandatory domain choice.

profiles.name: Armor Master

evidence.reason: Touch defence, damage reduction, fortification and critical immunity deepen durability already core to Fighter.

profiles.playerSummary: A Fighter who pushes armour and shield survival to its limit through touch defence, damage reduction and fortification.
profiles.tradeoff: Bravery, weapon training and weapon mastery are surrendered for purely personal defence.

profiles.name: Lore Warden

evidence.reason: Extra Intelligence skills and analytical combat secrets make scholarship mechanically central.

profiles.playerSummary: A scholarly Fighter who studies enemies, masters Intelligence skills and uses analytical combat secrets.
profiles.tradeoff: Medium and heavy armour and shields are lost, reducing the Fighter’s normal defensive ceiling.

profiles.name: Mutation Warrior

evidence.reason: Mutagen and discoveries can reshape physical ability and add wings, limbs or natural attacks.

profiles.playerSummary: A Fighter who replaces armour training with Alchemist mutagens and a sequence of bodily discoveries.
profiles.tradeoff: Defensive armour progression is reduced and the strongest physical boosts carry mutagen drawbacks and limited use.
